transcript:
Speaker 0: Hi, I'm Nadia Okoro, I'm a partner at Foundry Lane, we run a twelve-week accelerator for AI infrastructure startups.
Speaker 1: Nice to meet you. I'm building a voice agent that turns conference conversations into follow-ups.
Speaker 0: Love that, our founders live at events. Our winter batch applications close November 15th. Send me your deck and I'll flag it for the selection committee.
Speaker 1: Will do, I'll send the deck this week. Could you also intro me to the Driftwood founders? They're in your portfolio.
Speaker 0: Sure, I'll make that intro. My email is nadia at foundrylane dot vc.
summary: Met Nadia Okoro, partner at the Foundry Lane accelerator; winter batch closes Nov 15, she'll flag our deck and intro the Driftwood founders.
